meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读你给的文本，按 12 个认知维度各打 1–10 分，标出主导与阴影模式、张力对和推理拓扑，输出一份认知画像；多人文本可做对比。
howto.when: 当你提供文本、想知道作者怎么思考，或问「我的思维风格是什么」「分析这个人的推理方式」「认知画像」等，或提到 DHDNA 时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维方式，给 12 个维度打分
say.note: 输出完整认知画像与关键引文

say.text: 对比我和他这两篇文章的思维风格有什么不同
say.note: 先出各自画像，再给对比综合分析

say.text: 就我们这段对话，给我做一份自我认知画像
say.note: 会说明对话文本可能不全面

howto.what_en: Claude reads the text you give it, scores 12 cognitive dimensions 1-10, flags dominant and shadow patterns, tension pairs, and reasoning topology, then outputs a cognitive profile; several texts get compared.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text and want to see how its author thinks, or ask about your thinking style, cognitive profile, thinking pattern, or DHDNA.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this text's author and score all 12 dimensions.
say_en.note: Gives a full cognitive profile with key quotes.

say_en.text: Compare the thinking styles in my essay and his essay.
say_en.note: Individual profiles, then a comparison synthesis.

say_en.text: Profile my own thinking from this conversation.
say_en.note: Notes chat text may not show the full range.
